info.album: The Very Best of Billy Ocean

podcast.body: This R&B song broke onto the Hot 100 in December 1984 and ultimately peaked at number two. Despite being by an R&B artist, it was described as sounding like "Moody New Wave guitar rock," highlighting the widespread genre crossing of 1984. The track was notably co-written and co-produced by famed rock producer Robert John "Mutt" Lang. "It's R&B singer Billy Ocean with Love A Boy. I wanna be your lover, lover, mm, wanna be your lover, lover, lover, lover boy."

podcast.body: Produced by Mut Lang, teaming with Keith Diamond and Ocean, this single took Billy Ocean in an entirely different direction with a sleek, space-age sound. It fused the dance pop Billy Ocean had been doing with the synth rock Mut Lang had developed for other artists like Def Leppard and The Cars. The accompanying video fittingly looked like an extension of the George Lucas's Star Wars universe, and the song reached number two on the Hot 100 in early 1985. "Loverboy fused the dance pop Billy Ocean had been doing with the synth rock Mutt Lang had developed for Deaf Luppard and the Cars."
